| description = Handing the plans to the Coldain Lookout spawns Scarbrow Ga'Hruk (level 46+), and 8 of his orc friends (blue to level 53). 

They spawn just to the west of the Coldain camp (apprx 100 yards away), and more or less immediately rush the Dwarves (there does not seem enough time to Harmony them).

You will need to pull Scarbrow out of the pack, and kill him for his head. Scarbrow also has a (rare) chance to drop a Frozen Orb, a caster range item which is not required for any part of these quests.
